top_signals.title: China Coking Coal Hits Three-Month Low as Supply Recovers
top_signals.summary: Sluggish trading activity and steelmaking demand have combined with recovering domestic supply to push this week China’s coking coal prices to the lowest level since mid-August, a three-month low. Futures of coking coal, the one used in steelmaking, in Dalian dropped for the fourth trading session on Thursday, to 1,346 yuan ($201.90) per ton, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.
